# VicWaCI: Identifying wet and dry spells in Victoria (AGCD)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#Reading in required packages
library(ncdf4)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
#library(colorspace)
#library(DescTools)
#library(zoo)
```

Dataset details for ERA5 and AGCD monthly data
```{r}
AGCDset_monthly <- c("agcd_precip_monthly_regions", "agcd_v2-0-4_precip_total_", "_monthly_1900-2025.nc", "precip","1900-01-01")

ERA5set_monthly <- c("agcd_precip_monthly_regions", "agcd_v2-0-4_precip_total_", "_monthly_1900-2025.nc", "precip","1940-01-01")

```

Select relevant dataset set
```{r}
SelectedSet <- AGCDset_monthly
```


Reading in monthly AGCD/ERA5 precip files Victorian subregions and Victoria as a whole
```{r}
#Create list of files
#files <- list.files(path = "/Users/toz008/Documents/VICWaCI/VicWaCI_inputData/agcd_precip_monthly_regions", full.names = TRUE)
#files <- list.files(path = "/Users/toz008/Documents/VICWaCI/VicWaCI_inputData/era5_precip_monthly_regions", full.names = TRUE)
files <- list.files(path = paste0("/Users/toz008/Documents/VICWaCI/VicWaCI_inputData/",SelectedSet[1]), full.names = TRUE)

#Extracting region names from filenames
#regions <- str_remove(basename(files), "agcd_v2-0-4_precip_total_")
#regions <- str_remove(basename(regions), "_monthly_1900-2025.nc")
#regions <- str_remove(basename(files), "era5_precip_total_")
#regions <- str_remove(basename(regions), "_monthly_1940-2025.nc")
regions <- str_remove(basename(files), SelectedSet[2])
regions <- str_remove(basename(regions), SelectedSet[3])

#Read in precip data and assign each element in the list as the filename
#variable is 'precip' in AGCD and 'tp' in ERA5
#Precip_monthly_vec <- set_names(files, basename(files)) |> 
#  map(\(x) ncvar_get(nc_open(x), "precip"))
Precip_monthly_vec <- set_names(files, basename(files)) |> 
  map(\(x) ncvar_get(nc_open(x), SelectedSet[4]))

Precip_monthly_vec <- set_names(Precip_monthly_vec, regions)
```

Calculating monthly terciles
```{r}
#Create time vector
#time <- ymd(as.Date("1900-01-16"))+ dhours(ncvar_get(nc_open(files[[1]]),'time'))
#time <- ymd(as.Date("1940-01-31"))+ ddays(ncvar_get(nc_open(files[[1]]),'time'))
time <- seq(ymd(SelectedSet[5]), ymd("2025-12-01"), by = "month")
#Create list of dataframes
Precip_monthly_df <- map(Precip_monthly_vec, \(x) data.frame(Date = time, Year = year(time), Month = month(time), Precip = x))

#exclude month grouping if you want to calculate terciles with all months thrown into one bucket
Precip_monthly_df <- map(Precip_monthly_df, 
                         \(x) x  |>  
                           filter(Year >=1900) |> 
                           group_by(Month)  |>  
   mutate(Low_cutoff = quantile(Precip, 1/3, na.rm = TRUE), High_cutoff = quantile(Precip, 2/3, na.rm = TRUE))  |>  
   mutate(Tercile = if_else(Precip >= High_cutoff, 3, if_else(Precip <= Low_cutoff, 1, 2))) |> 
   mutate(Mean = mean(Precip)))

```

Calculating statistics around monthly events
```{r}
#calculating length of event, total rainfall in event and rainfall per month in each event, only keeping events greater than 2 consecutive months
Runs_summary <- Rainfall_monthly %>%
  group_by(Run_id = consecutive_id(Tercile)) %>%
  summarise(
    Tercile = first(Tercile),
    Start_Date = min(Date),
    End_Date = max(Date),
    Length = n(),
    Total_Rain = sum(Rain)) %>% 
  mutate(Rain_perMonth = Total_Rain/Length, Start_Month = month(Start_Date)) %>% 
#  filter(Length > 2 & Tercile !=2)
  filter(Length > 2)

#expanding out the runs dataset to get every month that appears in an event
Runs_summary_expand <- Runs_summary %>%
  group_by(Run_id) %>%
  reframe(
    Dates = seq(floor_date(Start_Date, "month"), 
                floor_date(End_Date, "month"), 
                by = "1 month"),
    Tercile = Tercile,
    Event_rain = Total_Rain
  ) %>% 
  mutate(Month = month(Dates), Year = year(Dates))
```

Check of tercile counts (same number of months in each tercile?)
```{r}
map(Precip_monthly_df, 
    \(x) x  |>  
  group_by(Tercile) |> 
  summarise(Terc_count = n()))
```

Tercile plots showing events of length 3 months and greater
```{r}

tercile_plot_list <- imap(Precip_monthly_df, function(df, name) {
  ggplot(df %>% group_by(grouping = rleid(Tercile)) %>% filter(n() >= 3), aes(x = Month, y = Year, fill = factor(Tercile)))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_y_reverse(expand=c(0,0),breaks = seq(from=1900, to=2025, by=10))+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1899, 2026))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1"="indianred", "2"= "beige", "3"="steelblue3"))+
  scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0), breaks = seq(1,12,1))+
  labs(x="Month",y="Year",fill = "Tercile",title = name)+
  theme_bw()+
#  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(linetype = "dashed", colour = "black"), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), panel.ontop = TRUE, panel.border = element_blank())
})

walk(tercile_plot_list, print)
```

```{r}
#save plots of monthly spells

  ggsave(filename = paste0("/Users/toz008/Documents/VICWaCI/Plots/",name, "_monthlySpells_ERA5.png"), plot = plot, width = 6, height = 6)
         })
```

```{r}
#saving timeseries of terciles to .csv

iwalk(Precip_monthly_df, ~ write_csv(.x, paste0(.y, ".csv")))
```

Point plot comparing monthly ERA5 and AGCD
```{r}
Precip_monthly_df_ERA5 <- Precip_monthly_df #assuming you have read in ERA5 first, then have to read in AGCD

df <- data.frame(ERA5 = Precip_monthly_df_ERA5[[5]]$Precip, AGCD = Precip_monthly_df[[5]]$Precip)
df$Year <- Precip_monthly_df_ERA5[[5]]$Year

ggplot(data=df)+geom_point(aes(x=AGCD,y=ERA5,fill=Year),shape=21)+scale_fill_gradientn(colors=c("yellow","gold","orange","red","firebrick"))+theme_bw()

ggsave(filename = "/Users/toz008/Documents/VICWaCI/Plots/Comparison_ERA5_AGCD_monthly.png", width = 8, height = 5)
```
